messages:
neha: Acme Health POC: streaming patient-summary keeps dropping and client throws JSON.parse errors. Demo in 24h, need a swarm.
anna: Browser console: 
`Error: Unexpected end of JSON input`
They captured the SSE stream and it shows partial JSON across events:
```
data: {\"id\":\"p-900\",\"name\":\"Liu\",\"notes\":\"...long text...\n\ndata: {\"id\":\"p-901\",\"name\":\"Khan\"  <-- truncated
```
dmitri: Likely causes: mid-record flush (server) or proxy/LB killing idle connection. EPIPE on server would indicate remote closed socket.
sam: Which client? EventSource polyfill in React. Short-term fixes: (1) ensure each SSE event carries a complete JSON object, (2) send heartbeat/comments every 10-15s, (3) client-side buffer and only parse when full object received.
anna: App proxy log shows: 
`upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream`
App stdout shows flush sizes then `Error: write EPIPE`.
dmitri: Confirms remote closed. We'll push a canary: disable mid-event flush and enable 12s heartbeat. Also add logging to correlate session id.
deploy-bot: canary: deployed rev c1d4 -> sse_heartbeat_sec=12, sse_send_full_events=true (13:42 UTC)
anna: Client tried canary: "no parse errors after 90 minutes, stream stayed open"
neha: That unblocks the demo, but security still has questions on audit/KMS. I'll loop SEC.
dmitri: Follow-ups: 24h canary soak, add reconnection alert, and publish SSE best-practices to customer docs.
neha: Thanks team, marking POC ready for demo. :tada:
